summary: Full frontend E2E testing of Planovia auth + cloud sync. All 10 requested flows pass. Registration, login, session persistence (cookie survives reload), wrong-password error, guest mode, merge dialog (behåll min planerare), sync push (add class -> persists via cloud after logout/re-login), Google button (no crash), UserMenu in expanded + collapsed sidebar, and regression navigation across all 7 sidebar pages – all green.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext initial /me returns 401 for guests -> logged as console error (expected, harmless, but produces noise in console). Could be silenced by treating 401 as expected on the guest path in authApi.js req().

CloudSync.jsx debounced push effect depends on the entire `planner` object; because usePlanner() returns a fresh object each render this may fire more often than needed. Not a correctness bug; consider depending on a serialized planner snapshot or a version counter.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar auto-collapses on viewports < 1024px AND state persists in localStorage (planner.sidebarCollapsed). If a previous test set collapsed=true, UserMenu will render user-menu-avatar + user-menu-logout-icon instead of user-menu + user-menu-logout even at >1024px viewports. Handle both selector variants when clicking logout. Also, when clearing state, remember to clear cookies via context.clear_cookies() AND localStorage/sessionStorage via page.evaluate. The Toaster is bottom-right (sonner). Merge dialog uses radix AlertDialog and does NOT auto-dismiss – must click keep or start-fresh testid.
